topics.title: Getting to know you
topics.opener_en: Hi! I'm your practice partner. Let's chat a little. Answer in English — full sentences if you can!

prompts.ask_en: What's your name and where are you from?
prompts.ask_es: ¿Cómo te llamas y de dónde eres?
prompts.model_en: My name is Carlos and I'm from Mexico.

prompts.ask_en: What do you do? Do you work or study?
prompts.ask_es: ¿A qué te dedicas? ¿Trabajas o estudias?
prompts.model_en: I work in an office and I'm also studying English.

prompts.ask_en: What do you like to do in your free time?
prompts.ask_es: ¿Qué te gusta hacer en tu tiempo libre?
prompts.model_en: In my free time I like watching series and going for a walk.

prompts.ask_en: Why are you learning English?
prompts.ask_es: ¿Por qué estás aprendiendo inglés?
prompts.model_en: I'm learning English to get a better job and to travel.

topics.title: Your weekend
topics.opener_en: Let's talk about your weekend! Tell me about it.

prompts.ask_en: What did you do last weekend?
prompts.ask_es: ¿Qué hiciste el fin de semana pasado?
prompts.model_en: Last weekend I relaxed at home and watched a movie with my family.

prompts.ask_en: Did you go anywhere nice?
prompts.ask_es: ¿Fuiste a algún lugar bonito?
prompts.model_en: Yes, I went to a park near my house. It was sunny and quiet.

prompts.ask_en: What do you usually do on Sundays?
prompts.ask_es: ¿Qué sueles hacer los domingos?
prompts.model_en: On Sundays I usually cook lunch and rest before the new week.

prompts.ask_en: What are your plans for next weekend?
prompts.ask_es: ¿Qué planes tienes para el próximo fin de semana?
prompts.model_en: Next weekend I'm going to visit my friends and maybe go running.

topics.title: Health & habits
topics.opener_en: Health is a great topic to practice. Let's chat about it!

prompts.ask_en: What does 'feeling good in your body' mean to you?
prompts.ask_es: ¿Qué significa para ti sentirte bien en tu cuerpo?
prompts.model_en: For me, feeling good means having energy and a positive mood, not only being thin.

prompts.ask_en: Do you think weight loss drugs are a good idea? Why?
prompts.ask_es: ¿Crees que los medicamentos para adelgazar son buena idea? ¿Por qué?
prompts.model_en: In my opinion they can help people with obesity, but they also have side effects.

prompts.ask_en: What healthy habits do you have?
prompts.ask_es: ¿Qué hábitos saludables tienes?
prompts.model_en: I try to drink a lot of water and walk every day.

prompts.ask_en: If a product promised to quiet 'food noise', what would you ask first?
prompts.ask_es: Si un producto prometiera calmar el 'ruido de comida', ¿qué preguntarías?
prompts.model_en: I would ask about the side effects and if it is safe for a long time.

topics.title: Travel & experiences
topics.opener_en: I love talking about travel. Where shall we start?

prompts.ask_en: What's the best place you have ever visited?
prompts.ask_es: ¿Cuál es el mejor lugar que has visitado?
prompts.model_en: The best place I've ever visited is the beach in Cancun. The water was amazing.

prompts.ask_en: Do you prefer the mountains or the sea? Why?
prompts.ask_es: ¿Prefieres la montaña o el mar? ¿Por qué?
prompts.model_en: I prefer the sea because I find it relaxing and I love swimming.

prompts.ask_en: Tell me about a trip that didn't go as planned.
prompts.ask_es: Cuéntame de un viaje que no salió como esperabas.
prompts.model_en: Once my flight was delayed for six hours, so I missed a concert. It was frustrating.

prompts.ask_en: If you could travel anywhere tomorrow, where would you go?
prompts.ask_es: Si pudieras viajar a cualquier lugar mañana, ¿a dónde irías?
prompts.model_en: If I could travel anywhere, I would go to Japan to see the culture and the food.

topics.title: Work & goals
topics.opener_en: Let's have a professional chat. Ready to practice?

prompts.ask_en: Tell me about what you do at work.
prompts.ask_es: Cuéntame qué haces en tu trabajo.
prompts.model_en: I'm responsible for customer service, so I help clients and solve their problems.

prompts.ask_en: What's the most challenging part of your job?
prompts.ask_es: ¿Cuál es la parte más difícil de tu trabajo?
prompts.model_en: The most challenging part is meeting tight deadlines while keeping quality high.

prompts.ask_en: Where do you see yourself in five years?
prompts.ask_es: ¿Dónde te ves en cinco años?
prompts.model_en: In five years I see myself leading a team and speaking English fluently.

prompts.ask_en: How would you convince someone to hire you?
prompts.ask_es: ¿Cómo convencerías a alguien de contratarte?
prompts.model_en: I would say that I'm reliable, hard-working, and eager to grow with the company.

topics.title: Ideas & opinions
topics.opener_en: Let's stretch your English with a deeper conversation.

prompts.ask_en: Do you think technology makes us more or less connected?
prompts.ask_es: ¿Crees que la tecnología nos conecta más o menos?
prompts.model_en: Arguably, technology connects us instantly, yet it can also make real conversations rarer.

prompts.ask_en: Is it better to be fast or thorough when making decisions?
prompts.ask_es: ¿Es mejor ser rápido o minucioso al decidir?
prompts.model_en: It depends on the stakes; for important decisions, I'd rather be thorough than hasty.

prompts.ask_en: What's one belief you've changed your mind about?
prompts.ask_es: ¿Sobre qué creencia has cambiado de opinión?
prompts.model_en: I used to think talent mattered most, but I've come to believe consistency matters far more.

prompts.ask_en: If you could fix one problem in the world, what would it be?
prompts.ask_es: Si pudieras resolver un problema del mundo, ¿cuál sería?
prompts.model_en: If I could fix one problem, it would be unequal access to education, since it shapes everything else.
